title: Jungle Jimmy Jazz Jive Trance
style: High-energy swinging jazz at 155–165 BPM with big band horn hits, warm piano comping, upright walking bass, brushed-to-stick drums, and clean jazz guitar chords. Trance-like repetitive rhythms with jive energy, playful male/female trade vocals, rapid-fire hook phrasing, and an energetic scat middle section. Stumbling syncopations lock into a steady, danceable groove with punchy rests.
